name: Mac OS 8
tagline: Platinum-era desktop patterns in soft, muted accents.
description: Mac OS 8 (1997) introduced the Platinum appearance along with the Desktop Pictures control panel, which for the first time let a full photograph — not just a tiled pattern — fill the desktop. There was still no picker for a plain background color, so solid backgrounds shipped as pictures: a set of iconic solid-color wallpapers, including the default soft lavender-blue. These are their colors — quiet, desaturated greens, browns, and roses that sat comfortably behind Platinum's calm gray chrome.

colors.name: French Blue (Light)
colors.note: The default desktop — a soft lavender-blue.

colors.name: Gray (Dithered)
colors.note: A solid gray desktop pattern, dithered from a lighter (#a5a5a5) and a darker (#969696) gray in an even 1:1 checkerboard. The two grays are close enough that the conventional pixel average and a linear-light gamma-corrected average both round to this same value.

colors.name: Gray (Light Partial)
colors.note: One of the two grays the dithered gray desktop is mixed from — the lighter shade filling half the checkerboard.

colors.name: Gray (Dark Partial)
colors.note: One of the two grays the dithered gray desktop is mixed from — the darker shade filling the other half.
